children: Ingram Micro Holding Corp reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.22B, up 20.8% year over year, while net income increased 31.8% to $131.08M and diluted EPS rose 35.7% to $0.57. Growth spanned all four geographic regions, with demand for GPU and AI infrastructure supporting Advanced Solutions.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Advanced Solutions grew 40%, Cloud-based Solutions increased 31%, and Client and Endpoint Solutions rose 10%; GPU and AI infrastructure contributed to demand.
Sales increased 31.5% in North America, 22.3% in Asia-Pacific, and 16.7% in Latin America.
Operating margin improved to 1.93% from 1.77%, supported by SG&A leverage, cost reductions, and Xvantage automation.
Ingram Micro is expanding cloud and higher-complexity solutions and investing in Xvantage, with development initiatives expected to finish by fiscal 2027.
